task.body:
Fix issue #24: MCP namespace docstring inconsistency.

`lib/tau/registries.ex` moduledoc says MCP tools register under the namespace `mcp__server__name`. At runtime the actual format is `"mcp__#{server_name}__#{tool_name}"` (see `lib/tau/mcp/server.ex:219`). The docstring reads as if `server` and `name` are literal strings, when they are variable substitutions.

## Required change

Update the moduledoc in `lib/tau/registries.ex` (and any other places that use the same docstring shape — search for `mcp__server__name`, `mcp__<server>__<name>`, or similar across `lib/`, `docs/`, and `.claude/skills/`) so it reads:

> MCP tools use `mcp__<server_name>__<tool_name>` (double-underscore separator).

Use the angle-bracket variable notation consistently so the reader can't confuse the variables with literal strings.

## Verification

- `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` — exit 0
- `mix format --check-formatted` — exit 0
- `mix credo --strict <changed files>` — exit 0
- `mix test` — no regressions (this is a pure docstring change)
- `grep -rn "mcp__server__name\|mcp__<server>__<name>"` returns nothing if all sites updated

Report each command's exit status with relevant verbatim output. Keep the change minimal — docstring text only, no behavioural code changes.

implementer.stdout_excerpt:
The task-agent completed the fix. Here's what happened:

**Finding:** `lib/tau/registries.ex` and `lib/tau/mcp/server.ex` already used the correct `mcp__<server_name>__<tool_name>` angle-bracket notation. The only site needing a fix was `priv/system_prompts/default.txt` line 10, which used `mcp__<server>__` (truncated, missing `_name` suffix).

**Change:** Updated `priv/system_prompts/default.txt` to use `mcp__<server_name>__` consistently.

**Verification:**

| Gate | Status |
|---|---|
| `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` | EXIT 0 |
| `mix format --check-formatted` | EXIT 1 — **pre-existing** failure in `lib/tau/burrito_steps/relink_termbox.ex`, confirmed present before this change |
| `mix credo --strict` (changed file) | EXIT 0 |
| `mix test` | EXIT 0 — 384 tests, 0 failures |
| `grep` for old notation | EXIT 0 — no matches |

The pre-existing `mix format` failure in `relink_termbox.ex` is unrelated to this change and should be addressed separately.
